title: Buttery Irish Fennel Dumplings
description: A hearty Irish-inspired dish featuring buttery dumplings, crunchy fennel, and a touch of nostalgia.
instructions: Peel the fennel bulbs and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the fennel pieces and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the dumpling mix, milk, and egg. Mix until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place the dumplings on top of the fennel mixture in the skillet.
Dot the top of the dumplings with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the dumplings are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot, topped with additional salted butter if desired.
